title: Display any CSV file as a searchable, filterable, pretty HTML table

text: Ha, I'm working on a similar utility with some extra features also enabling WASM that might help in case of larger files.

kids.text: WASM support actually sounds really useful here. Are you compiling with Rust or Go?
Rust mostly. The binary size is pretty reasonable so far.
Curious how it performs with multi-GB files compared to native tooling.

text: This is one of those tiny tools that ends up saving hours over time.

kids.text: Yeah, especially when you need something quick without spinning up a whole pipeline.
Exactly. Simplicity matters more than feature count sometimes.
The best tools are usually the boring ones that just work.

text: Nice project. The docs were surprisingly clear too.

kids.text: Agreed, setup took less than 2 minutes for me.
